reviews.title: Miracle
reviews.author: Gloria L.
reviews.body: I was skeptical at first, I’ve tried many different types of shapewear in the past but encountered problems such as the fat just being pushed up, unwieldy clasps, top folding down, and the accursed red lines from where the shapewear duh into me. These leggings I swear are magic! They stayed up all day, I look like I’ve lost 20 pounds, they’re soooo soft like butter. This was so worth, I’m glad I also purchased a pair of panties and cycling shorts. I also bought an extra pair as a gift for my mom this Christmas. I was so pleasantly surprised with the little message each item comes with. Thank you for giving me confidence and making me feel beautiful.

reviews.title: Very comfortable and they work!
reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.body: I will admit, I was a bit skeptical about ordering these at first because of all of the bad reviews. But I ordered anyway and guess what. They showed up and are automatically my favorite leggings I own. I am 5'5" and 153 pounds, and these leggings make me look 20 pounds lighter than I am. I highly recommend these. They do not roll down and they feel like an extra skin! I can hardly even tell they're there! Will be ordering more Empetua products in the future!

reviews.title: Just what I wanted!
reviews.author: Tedra
reviews.body: So I was excited to grab these. they'd been on my list of must haves for a while now. I bought two pairs originally in 3xl. They had way too much room in them for me. The crotch part sagged and the legs could easily fold over my foot. I'm 5'2 and about 230 lbs. I got in contact with customer service and right away they were helpful. suggested that I go down a size and it was simple as asking for a different show in a shoe store. so seamless. Thank you! new size came, 2xl. They are great! at first I thought I needed to go down a size, given that I still had a little leg room in them but if I pull them up enough, its not a problem. Plus I don't want them to be super super tight where I can't breath if I sit down. I wear these to do yoga and work in my garden since we're still on lockdown. But I can move and hold everything in. Which is good for me.

reviews.title: The Essentials leggings are my go-to!

reviews.title: So many compliments
reviews.author: Erin Maniscalco
reviews.body:
With my 3 c-section babies my stomach was left fluffy and made my mid section look like I was hiding loaves of bread stuffed into my loosened, poorly fitting yoga pants. 
I recently started working out at the gym to get healthy and it’s left my bread loaves a little flatter, but what would I do with this extra skin? Ugh!
I saw the squat-proof design and the high waist and I had to give them a try. I bough both the XXXL and XXL size and was surprised to find that they were so comfortable! I wore them to Burn Bootcamp (gym) and a few of my workout buddies complimented me on how good I looked. 

But wait, that’s not the best part! Remember that loose flabby 
 belly? Well, in regular work out pants, the belly skin would flap up and down, smacking my legs as I ran...it literally sounded like I was clapping my hands, needless to say it’s embarrassing to clap for yourself when you don’t mean to.
Well Shapermint Empetua high waisted shaper leggings keep my extra skin held up against my torso so that it can’t move. It’s like a sports bra for my Fupa! 
I Love them so much I ordered 2 more in the next size down fir when I lose some more weights. Now, since I no longer have to worry about muffin-top or wardrobe malfunctions I don’t intend to miss a day of workouts. This momma is hooked on Shapermint!

reviews.title: Rarely Get Dressed Without’em
reviews.author: Sherbert R.
reviews.body:
I have never worn these shaper leggings without clothes on top of them. I’m not a legging type of girl. Lol but I will say I’ve initially purchased these to have great support under my clothes as well as help to keep me warm during the colder months. I must say, that I wear them all year long. 

I even wear the ones that are made like biking shorts with my dresses, skirts and shorts, 

The long leggings keep me warm all winter long as well as give me that extra boost of confidence with great posture because I know I’m looking fab! So whether you’re looking for a great pair of leggings or something to give you great support and warmth under your clothes, don’t walk run to get these!

Oh, and, be sure you size down If you’re purchasing them for great support under your outfit! Believe me, they will be the best shape where you’ve ever purchased. So comfy!

reviews.title: Curvy and loving it!

reviews.body: This makes my butt look so good. It’s different from other body-shaping clothes because it doesn’t push all of my extra chub up - it evenly disperses it and I feel more comfortable with the skin I’m in.

reviews.title: Love them and going to order another pair!

reviews.body: I am 58 years old and have never worn leggings before. These are thicker and more sturdy than I envisioned and I LOVE them! So comfy, doesn’t roll down at the waist, can’t see cellulite and not so tight I can’t breathe.
